title: Auto Parts Supplier for Philippines | Autologic Industries
description: Autologic Industries is an auto parts supplier for Philippines buyers, exporting motorcycle and tricycle clutch parts and die-cast components.
banner_desc: Motorcycle, tricycle and casting components exported from India for buyers in the Philippines.
hero_sub: Clutch, Brake & Engine Parts for Bikes, Tricycles & OEMs
hero_alt: Clutch assembly from the Autologic range for Philippine buyers
hero: Autologic Industries is an IATF 16949 certified manufacturer in Delhi and an auto parts supplier for Philippines importers, distributors and assemblers. We export clutch systems, brake shoes, engine parts and aluminium castings.

Motorcycles and tricycles are part of daily life across the Philippines, from Metro Manila to provincial towns. Tricycles built on motorcycles carry passengers all day, which puts heavy demand on clutches. Browse our range below. Every component is tested before dispatch, and our team can help you plan a first order for your market.

network.title: Why Philippine Buyers Work With Us
paras: We have made drivetrain parts for more than 25 years and test every component before dispatch.
Sourcing clutch, brake and casting parts from one manufacturer keeps ordering simple and quality consistent.
Our team can cross-check the part numbers you currently stock and recommend matching parts from our range.

network.title: Shipping Parts to the Philippines
paras: Orders travel by sea in moisture-protected, palletised export packing to the port you choose, with complete documents for customs.
Different product lines can share one container, and repeat shipments can be scheduled.
Repeat orders can be scheduled so fast-moving clutch parts stay in stock between shipments.

cta.title: Sourcing parts for the Philippine market?
cta.text: Share your part list, models or drawings with quantities. Our export team will confirm fitment and send a quotation for delivery to the Philippines. Samples can be arranged before your first volume order, so you can check fit on local models.

faq_intro: Quick answers for importers, distributors and assemblers in the Philippines. Our export team replies to enquiries with fitment notes, packing details and clear commercial terms.
faqs: Do your clutch parts suit tricycle motorcycles?
Our two wheeler clutch parts are built for heavy daily use. Share the motorcycle model and we will confirm fitment.
Can I order a mixed shipment?
Yes. We combine product lines in one consignment and label cartons by model.
Can you make parts to our drawings?
Yes. Our die casting and CNC lines produce components from drawings or samples after a feasibility review.
Yes. Samples let you confirm fit and finish before ordering in volume.
Do you supply brake shoes for three-wheelers?
Yes. Our drum brake shoes have fade-resistant linings and long lining life.
Is the packing suitable for humid conditions?
Yes. Friction parts are sealed against moisture and consignments are palletised for sea transit.
Can I order parts for several motorcycle models in one shipment?
Yes. Mixed orders are packed and labelled by model so they are easy to sort and stock on arrival.
